purpose: Public FiveM vehicle add-ons with creator links and server setup notes.

items.name: ONX Declasse Granger Revamp + Alamo
items.author: ONX, L’Kid and Tidemo
items.description: Two civilian SUVs based on the Granger platform. The Alamo is the shorter variant.
items.requirementLabel: FiveM server · Free ONX store package
requirements: Claim the free package on the ONX store. Follow the creator’s instructions for putting the vehicle resources under [onx_vehicles] and starting that group in server.cfg.
Test the vehicles through your server’s vehicle spawner. The standalone download does not include the separate ONX traffic pack.
items.previewCaption: Granger 3600LX screenshot from the ONX release.

items.name: Grodd Customs Vehicle Pack
items.author: Grodd Customs
items.description: Seventeen civilian add-ons, including modified sedans, wagons, muscle cars and SUVs. The release lists the tuning options and spawn names for each.
requirements: Use the FiveM resource folder and add ensure groddcustoms to server.cfg.
Use the release’s model names when configuring your spawner or dealership. For a first test, the author lists senhart and oracle_gts.

items.name: Driving School Blista
items.author: Nukepug Designs
items.description: A Blista with a driving school livery for lessons and roleplay events.
requirements: Install the npdsblista folder from the repository and add ensure npdsblista to server.cfg.
Use npdsblista as the model name in your authorized vehicle spawner or driving school resource.

items.name: Maibatsu Sunrise R Hycade
items.author: SNStudios
items.credits: SNStudios for the Hycade body kit. The release credits Boywond for the original model.
items.description: A custom Sunrise R with a Hycade body kit and a separate FiveM resource in the release.
requirements: Use the hycsunrise resource from the archive’s FiveM folder. Start hycsunrise in server.cfg.
Use hycsun as the model name in your spawner. The resource and model names are different.
